entity: Federal (GNIS) place names still containing "Negro", and the pace of their renaming vs "Squaw" names
what_we_add: 438 names now (426 current, 12 historical); 105 list the n-word as an older name; 2020-23 renamings: 641 "Squaw" vs at least 41 "Negro" or n-word
why: Atmos 2022: 469 GNIS names still carry the 'replacement word' (the lead's own n-word history shows that word is "Negro"); 469 vs 438 is within 25% and in the same direction. CRS/Interior put the Squaw renamings near 650-657, in line with 641; no source makes the Negro-vs-Squaw comparison.
